People CorpIdQ signs in can assume this role.

  Anyone                unknown           No grant is placed with people who have no account anywhere.
  Anyone on a platform  exact             No grant is placed at a whole platform.
  A named outsider      exact             No grant is placed with a named outsider.
  Your pipelines        exact             No grant is confined to owners declared as yours.
  Your people           exact             No grant trusts a SAML provider declared as yours.
  ──
  SAML sign-ins         unknown  grant 1  People CorpIdQ signs in can assume this role; who they are is set in CorpIdQ.

Each of these can narrow the rings and was not read: the organisation's resource control policies, the calling accounts' service control policies and this account's identity providers.
owners declared  saml:arn:aws:iam::123456789012:saml-provider/CorpIdP
owner unmatched  saml:arn:aws:iam::123456789012:saml-provider/CorpIdP · no grant that admits is pinned to it, so declaring it moves nothing
